words.example: Gold is an element: it has only one type of atom.
words.exampleTranslation: 金是一种元素：它只含一种原子。

evidence.quote: is the simplest form of chemical matter and contains only one type of atom
Elements Oxygen, aluminum, gold, sodium

words.example: Table salt is a compound: two different elements joined together.
words.exampleTranslation: 食盐是一种化合物：由两种不同的元素结合而成。

evidence.quote: Sodium chloride (NaCl), common table salt, is an example of a compound
are chemical combinations of two or more atoms of different elements

words.example: A chemical change makes a new substance, like a nail enhancement.
words.exampleTranslation: 化学变化会产生新物质，比如做加固甲。

evidence.quote: This change is caused by chemical reactions that create new chemical substances
Creating a nail enhancement is a good example of a chemical reaction.

words.example: Acetone is a solvent: it dissolves old nail polish.
words.exampleTranslation: 丙酮是一种溶剂：它能溶解旧甲油。

evidence.quote: When used as a polish remover, acetone dissolves old polish (the solute).
The solvent (SAHL-vent) is the substance that dissolves the solute

words.example: Glitter polish is a suspension: the glitter can separate from the polish.
words.exampleTranslation: 亮片甲油是悬浮液：亮片会和甲油分离。

evidence.quote: An example of a suspension is the glitter in nail polish, which can separate from the polish.
They are unstable and separate over time

words.example: An emulsifier holds oil and water together, like egg yolk in mayonnaise.
words.exampleTranslation: 乳化剂能让油和水保持混合，比如蛋黄酱里的蛋黄。

evidence.quote: is an ingredient that brings two normally incompatible materials together and binds them into a uniform and fairly stable mixture
the egg yolk in mayonnaise emulsifies the oil droplets and distributes them uniformly in the water

words.example: Water and alcohol are miscible: they mix and stay mixed.
words.exampleTranslation: 水和酒精是可互溶的：混合后会一直保持混合。

evidence.quote: Water and alcohol are examples of miscible liquids
When these substances are mixed together, they will stay mixed, forming a solution.

words.example: A product with a pH above 7 is alkaline.
words.exampleTranslation: pH 高于 7 的产品是碱性的。

evidence.quote: and a pH above 7 indicates an alkaline solution
Alkalis have a pH above 7.

words.example: Nail enhancement products give off heat as they harden: an exothermic reaction.
words.exampleTranslation: 加固甲产品变硬时会放出热量：这是放热反应。

evidence.quote: When certain chemical reactions release energy in the form of heat, it is called an exothermic reaction
example of an exothermic reaction is a nail product that hardens

words.example: Monomers are single molecules that join to make a polymer.
words.exampleTranslation: 单体是能连接起来组成聚合物的单个分子。

evidence.quote: The individual molecules that join to make the polymer are called monomers

words.example: A catalyst speeds up reactions, so nail enhancements harden quickly.
words.exampleTranslation: 催化剂能加快反应，所以加固甲很快就变硬。

evidence.quote: is a substance that speeds up a chemical reaction
Catalysts are found in every type of nail enhancement product and are the reason why nail enhancements harden so quickly.

words.example: A cross-linker joins polymer chains into a strong net.
words.exampleTranslation: 交联剂把聚合物链连接成一张牢固的网。

evidence.quote: is a monomer that joins different polymer chains together
Cross-links create strong net-like polymers.

words.example: Volatile solvents in polish evaporate very easily into the air.
words.exampleTranslation: 甲油里的挥发性溶剂很容易蒸发到空气中。

evidence.quote: contain carbon (organic) and evaporate very easily (volatile)
Volatile organic solvents such as ethyl acetate and isopropyl alcohol are used in nail polish

words.example: In chemistry, organic means a substance contains carbon.
words.exampleTranslation: 在化学里，有机（organic）是指物质含有碳。

evidence.quote: the word organic simply means that a substance contains the element carbon

words.example: Plasticizers keep polish flexible, so it can bend.
words.exampleTranslation: 增塑剂让甲油保持柔韧，可以弯曲。

evidence.quote: plasticizers (plas-tih-SY-zerz), which are used to keep the products flexible

words.example: A UV stabilizer stops sunlight from fading the polish color.
words.exampleTranslation: 紫外线稳定剂能防止阳光让甲油褪色。

evidence.quote: which control color stability and prevent sunlight from causing fading or discoloration

words.example: All nail enhancements and nail glues belong to the acrylics family.
words.exampleTranslation: 所有加固甲和美甲胶水都属于丙烯酸类。

evidence.quote: All nail enhancements and adhesives are based on a family of chemical ingredients called the acrylics

words.example: Nail glues and wraps are based on cyanoacrylates.
words.exampleTranslation: 美甲胶水和包甲都以氰基丙烯酸酯为基础。

evidence.quote: All nail adhesives (glues) and wraps are based on cyanoacrylates

words.example: The FDA and most state boards say not to use MMA monomer.
words.exampleTranslation: FDA 和大多数州美容委员会都说不要用 MMA 单体。

evidence.quote: Methyl methacrylate monomer (MMA) (METH-ul meth-AH-kril-ayt MON-uh-mur) is a substance
The FDA and most state boards of cosmetology say not to use it! This is the most important reason.

words.example: Acid-based primers are corrosive: they can burn skin and eyes.
words.exampleTranslation: 酸性结合剂有腐蚀性：会灼伤皮肤和眼睛。

evidence.quote: Acid-based primers are corrosive and can cause painful burns and scars to soft tissue and eyes.

words.example: A primer helps nail products stick better to the nail.
words.exampleTranslation: 结合剂能让美甲产品更好地附着在指甲上。

evidence.quote: is a substance that improves adhesion
Many primers act as double-sided sticky tape to anchor monomers firmly to the surface of the natural nail plate.

words.example: Touching dusty containers again and again can cause overexposure.
words.exampleTranslation: 一次又一次接触沾满粉尘的容器，会造成过度接触。

evidence.quote: Repeatedly handling these items will cause overexposure if the items are not kept clean.
Overexposure is prolonged, repeated, or long-term exposure that can cause sensitivity.

words.example: Glycerin is a sweet, colorless, oily moisturizer used in creams.
words.exampleTranslation: 甘油是一种带甜味、无色、油状的保湿成分，用在护肤霜里。

evidence.quote: is a sweet, colorless, oily substance. It is used as a solvent and as a moisturizer in skin and body creams.

words.example: Methylene glycol hardeners make thin, weak nails stiffer.
words.exampleTranslation: 甲二醇硬甲油能让又薄又软的指甲变硬。

evidence.quote: methylene glycol, an ingredient that creates bridges or cross-links between the keratin strands
making the plate stiffer and more resistant to bending and breaking
These products are useful for thin and weak nail plates

words.example: Polymerization joins monomers into long chains called polymers.
words.exampleTranslation: 聚合把单体连接成长链，也就是聚合物。

evidence.quote: The chemical reaction that makes polymers is called polymerization
The individual molecules that join to make the polymer are called monomers

words.example: Water is the universal solvent: it dissolves the most substances.
words.exampleTranslation: 水是万能溶剂：它能溶解的物质最多。

evidence.quote: Water is known as the universal solvent because it has the ability to dissolve more substances than any other solvent.

words.example: Soap is a surfactant: it lets oil and water mix.
words.exampleTranslation: 肥皂是一种表面活性剂：它能让油和水混合。

evidence.quote: are substances that allow oil and water to mix, or emulsify
Soaps were the first surfactants.

words.example: Fumes come from burning things, like candles and cigarettes.
words.exampleTranslation: 烟雾来自燃烧的东西，比如蜡烛和香烟。

evidence.quote: They usually result from burning substances, such as candles, incense, cigarettes
Fumes (FYOOMZ) are a blend of soot-like particles mixed with vapors.

words.example: Monomer liquid forms vapors when it evaporates into the air.
words.exampleTranslation: 单体液蒸发到空气中时会形成蒸气。

evidence.quote: Vapors (VAY-purs) are formed when liquids evaporate
Monomer liquids (even odorless monomer), UV gels, wrap resins, and adhesives all form vapors

words.example: A film former in topcoat leaves a hard, shiny film.
words.exampleTranslation: 亮油里的成膜剂会留下一层坚硬、光亮的膜。

evidence.quote: Typically the main ingredients are methacrylic or cellulose-type film formers.
create hard, shiny, or matte films after the solvent has evaporated

meaning.en: Liquids that mix and stay mixed
meaning.zh: 能混合、并一直保持混合的液体

meaning.en: Liquids that separate, like oil and water
meaning.zh: 会分开的液体，比如油和水

tip.en: Miscible looks like "mix". Im- means not: immiscible liquids, like oil and water, won't stay mixed.
tip.zh: miscible 看起来像 mix（混合）。im- = 不：immiscible 就是不互溶，像油和水，混了也会分开。中文多一个“不”字。

evidence.quote: liquids are mutually soluble, meaning that they can be mixed together to form solutions
When these substances are mixed together, they will stay mixed, forming a solution.
liquids are not capable of being mixed together to form stable solutions. Water and oil are two examples.
They can be mixed together but will separate when they are left sitting still.

meaning.zh: 稳定的混合物，比如盐水

meaning.en: Visible bits that separate, like glitter in polish
meaning.zh: 看得见的颗粒会分离，比如甲油里的亮片

meaning.en: Oil and water held together, like lotion
meaning.zh: 油和水被拉在一起，比如护手乳

tip.en: Solution: you can't see the salt. Suspension: you can see the glitter. Emulsion: creamy lotion, oil plus water.
tip.zh: 溶液（solution）：盐溶化了，看不见。悬浮液（suspension）：亮片“悬浮”在里面，看得见。乳液（emulsion）：像护手乳，油加水。

evidence.quote: is a stable, uniform mixture of two or more substances
Again, salt water is an example of a solution with a solid dissolved in a liquid.
Solutions contain small particles that are invisible to the naked eye.
The particles are generally visible to the naked eye
An example of a suspension is the glitter in nail polish, which can separate from the polish.
is an unstable physical mixture of two or more immiscible substances (substances that normally will not stay mixed) plus a special ingredient called an emulsifier
Haircolor, shampoos, conditioners, hand lotions, and facial creams are oil-in-water emulsions.

meaning.en: Form changes; no new substance is made
meaning.zh: 形态改变，但不产生新物质

meaning.en: A reaction makes a new substance
meaning.zh: 化学反应产生了新物质

tip.en: Physical: same stuff, new form, like polish drying. Chemical: a new substance, like a nail enhancement hardening.
tip.zh: 物理变化：还是原来的东西，只是形态变了，比如甲油变干。化学变化：产生了新物质，比如加固甲变硬。

evidence.quote: is a change in the form or physical properties of a substance, without a chemical reaction or the creation of a new substance
A physical change occurs when nail polish is applied onto nails and the solvent evaporates
This change is caused by chemical reactions that create new chemical substances
Creating a nail enhancement is a good example of a chemical reaction.

meaning.en: Reaction that needs heat from outside
meaning.zh: 需要从外面吸收热量的反应

tip.en: Exothermic starts like "exit": heat goes out. Endothermic: heat must go in. A hardening nail enhancement gets warm: exothermic.
tip.zh: exothermic 开头像 exit（出口）：热量往外走，放热。endothermic：热量要进来，吸热。加固甲变硬时会发热：放热反应。

evidence.quote: When certain chemical reactions release energy in the form of heat, it is called an exothermic reaction
example of an exothermic reaction is a nail product that hardens
is a chemical reaction that requires the absorption of energy or heat from an external source for the reaction to actually occur

tip.en: Sour lemon juice is acidic: below 7. Alkaline products feel slippery, like soap: above 7. Pure water: neutral.
tip.zh: “酸”就是酸味：柠檬汁是酸性，pH 低于 7。碱性的东西摸起来滑滑的、像肥皂，pH 高于 7。纯水 pH 7，是中性。

evidence.quote: A pH of 7 is a neutral solution, a pH below 7 indicates an acidic solution
and a pH above 7 indicates an alkaline solution
They feel slippery and soapy on the skin.
Pure (distilled) water has a pH of 7

meaning.en: One single molecule that can join others
meaning.zh: 能和别的分子连接的单个分子

meaning.en: A short chain of joined molecules
meaning.zh: 由分子连成的一条短链

meaning.en: A very long chain of molecules
meaning.zh: 由分子连成的很长的链

tip.en: Mono = one, poly = many. Oligomer is in the middle: a short chain.
tip.zh: mono = 一个，poly = 很多。oligomer 在中间：一条短链。看中文：单体是单个；寡聚物的“寡”是少，连得少；聚合物是大量聚在一起。

evidence.quote: The individual molecules that join to make the polymer are called monomers
is a short chain of monomers that has had the growth of its chain halted before it became a polymer
The molecules in the product join together in extremely long chains
These gigantic chains of molecules are called polymers
